effects: Pulls exactly `assets` USDC from the signer into the vault (safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets)), using the signer's USDC allowance to the vault.
Mints vault shares (Api3CoreUSDC) to `onBehalf`. The number is previewDeposit(assets), set by the share price after fees accrue. There is no minimum.
Accrues interest first, which may mint fee shares to the fee recipients. This dilutes the price slightly but moves nothing the signer holds.
Sends the deposited USDC on to the liquidity adapter. This is vault-internal and does not change what the signer gets.
formats.shown: Deposit 1 USDC for <onBehalf>, with the share ticker Api3CoreUSDC and the share recipient as fields.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares received is not shown and has no minimum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol deposit(): `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets);`, computed from storage. Case 0: signer received 0.5005 Api3CoreUSDC, and the screen gives only the ticker and the recipient.
findings.fix: None possible from calldata. The ticker and recipient fields already say which asset arrives and where.

cases.notes: 1 USDC out is shown exactly. Shares in: asset and recipient are shown, but the amount (0.5005) is set by the share price and not shown.

effects: Pulls USDC from the signer. The amount is previewMint(shares), rounded up and set by the share price after fees accrue. Nothing caps it except the signer's allowance.
Accrues interest first, which may mint fee shares. Then sends the USDC on to the liquidity adapter (vault-internal).
formats.shown: Mint <shares> Api3CoreUSDC for <onBehalf>. The 'Deposit asset' field shows only 'USDC', with no amount.

findings.title: mint: the USDC amount taken from the signer is never shown and has no bound.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol mint(): `uint256 assets = previewMint(shares); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);` then `safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets)`. Case 1: 0.000001 USDC left the signer, and the screen shows only 'Deposit asset: USDC'.
findings.fix: No amount can be derived from calldata. A label like 'Pays USDC (amount set by share price)' would say the cost is variable.

findings.title: mint: the intent 'Mint' does not say the signer pays USDC into the vault.
findings.evidence: descriptor intent "Mint", interpolatedIntent "Mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}". Case 1 reader had to guess from a separate field that USDC leaves the wallet.
findings.fix: Use intent 'Deposit USDC for shares' and interpolatedIntent 'Deposit USDC to mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}'.

cases.notes: USDC out: the asset is named, the amount (1 base unit) is not. The shares went to 0xdead (signer null), which is shown correctly.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Sends exactly `assets` USDC from the vault to `receiver`.
Burns previewWithdraw(assets) shares from `onBehalf` (rounded up, set by the share price).
If the signer is not `onBehalf`, spends that many shares of the signer's allowance from onBehalf.
Accrues interest and may pull liquidity back from the adapter (vault-internal).
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly 0.1 USDC to <receiver>, with the owner (onBehalf) as a field.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of shares burned from the owner is not shown and has no maximum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw(): `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets);` then exit() `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)`. Case 2: 0.04967 Api3CoreUSDC burned from the signer, with no share amount on screen.
findings.fix: None possible from calldata. Optionally mention in the intent that vault shares are burned from the owner.

cases.notes: 0.1 USDC in to the signer is shown exactly. Shares out: the reader saw their Api3 balance go down but not the share amount.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Burns exactly `shares` vault shares from `onBehalf`. If the signer is not onBehalf, spends the signer's share allowance from onBehalf.
Sends previewRedeem(shares) USDC to `receiver`. The amount is set by the share price, rounded down, with no minimum.
Accrues interest and may pull liquidity back from the adapter (vault-internal).
formats.shown: Redeem 499.55 Api3CoreUSDC to <receiver>, with the owner as a field. Nothing names the asset paid out.

findings.title: redeem: the asset the signer receives (USDC) is never named on screen.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol exit(): `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets);`. The descriptor has no underlyingTicker field for redeem, though mint uses `$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker`. Case 3: 1003.57 USDC arrived; the reader wrote 'likely USDC, not shown on screen'.
findings.fix: Add a field {label: 'Receive asset', format: raw, value: $.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker} and say 'for USDC' in the interpolatedIntent.

findings.title: redeem: the USDC amount received is not shown and has no minimum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol redeem(): `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares);`, computed from storage. Case 3: 1003.573252 USDC received, with no amount on screen.

cases.notes: Shares out are shown exactly. USDC in: the recipient is shown, but the asset is not named and the amount is not shown.
